mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_deposit_refund (user_id, amount, status, reason, apply_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{amount}, 0, #{reason}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_deposit_refund WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY apply_time DESC

choose.otherwise: SELECT r.*, u.username, u.real_name FROM t_deposit_refund r LEFT JOIN t_user u ON r.user_id = u.id ORDER BY r.apply_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

choose.when: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_deposit_refund WHERE status = #{status}
